name: Coldplay Affair AI
tagline: Coldplay Affair AI turns two photos into the viral Coldplay affair filter video
description: Coldplay Affair AI is the web version of the Coldplay affair filter trend that took over TikTok. No CapCut, no filming and no green screen: upload one clear photo of each person, or one photo of both, and the AI puts them on its own AI-made concert big screen in their own clothes. Each video plays the whole moment in one continuous 12-second shot: on the big screen, caught, hide and duck, and the crowd going wild. You get a vertical 9:16 720p MP4 with crowd sound and no watermark, rendered in about 3 minutes, ready for TikTok, Reels or the group chat. Failed renders get the credit back automatically and photos are deleted within 24 hours. Uses AI-generated people and scenery only, with no real concert footage. Independent tool, not affiliated with Coldplay.
